MOTIVE_FIVE_WAVE_FAMILY.minimum_missing_requirement: An explicitly protected non-circular terminal/base validation route for a complete source-specific motive structure.
additional_blockers: corrective child-family proof for diagonal routes

CORRECTIVE_THREE_WAVE_FAMILY.minimum_missing_requirement: An explicitly protected non-circular terminal/base validation route that does not presuppose an existing motive or corrective family certificate.

terminal_base_case.finding: No approved source defines an indivisible wave, a finite positive recursion terminus, or permission to certify family from the finest visible swings.
terminal_base_case.p023_effect: Missing or concealed subdivisions require finer data or unresolved internals; P023 cannot create positive validity.

completion.finding: The corpus uses complete/developing/confirmed language but supplies no trusted general completion producer or deterministic authority. Cardinality, visibility, caller assertion, and last observed bar are insufficient.

position_authority.finding: Ending diagonals, triangles, X waves, and several component rules require exact Elliott positions. OrderedChildBinding preserves only caller-proposed order and does not prove those roles.

subject_binding.AnalyzedWaveSubject: Sufficient for exact identity and opaque provenance transport only.
subject_binding.OrderedChildBinding: Sufficient to preserve exact parent/child object identities and order as input, but not to prove parentage or Elliott positions.
subject_binding.future_requirement: A reviewed producer must verify its own authoritative subject provenance; position-dependent producers additionally need a separately trusted position/parent binding.
